a: अरुंधती — [न रुंधती प्रतिरोधकारिणी] 1 A medicinal climbing plant. --2 N. of the wife of Vasiṣṭha; अन्वासितमरुंधत्या स्वाहयेव हविर्भुजं R. 1. 56. --3 The morning star personified as the wife of Vasiṣṭha; one of the Pleiades. --4 N. of the daughter of प्राचेतसदक्ष, one of the 10 wives of Dharma. [In mythology Arundhatī is represented as the wife of the sage Vasiṣṭha, one of the 7 sages. She was one of the 9 daughters of Kardama Prajāpati by Devahūti. She is regarded as the highest pattern of conjugal excellence and wifely devotion and is so invoked by the bridegroom at nuptial ceremonies. Though a woman she was regarded with the same-even more-veneration as the Saptarṣis; cf. Ku. 6. 12: तामगौरवभेदेन मुनींश्चापश्यदीश्वरः . स्त्री पुमानित्यनास्थैषा वृत्तं हि महितं सताम् .. cf. also Janaka's remarks in. U. 4. 10. She, like her husband, was the guide and controller of Raghu's line in her own department, and acted as guardian angel to Sītā after she had been abandoned by Rāma. It is said that Arundhatī (the star) is not seen by persons whose end has approached: cf. Suśruta: न पश्यति सनक्षत्रां यस्तु देवीमरुंधतीं . ध्रुवमाकाशगंगां च तं वदंति गतायुषं ..; see H. 1. 76 also]. --5 The tongue (personified). --Comp. --जातिः, --नाथः, --पतिः N. of Vasiṣṭha, one of the seven Ṛṣis or stars in the Ursa Major --दर्शनन्यायः see under न्याय.

a: अरुण — a. (णा, --णी f.) [ऋ-उनन्; cf. Uṇ. 3. 60] 1 Reddish brown, tawny, red, ruddy (of the colour of the morning as opposed to the darkness of night); प्रत्याख्यातविशेषकं कुरबकं श्यामावदातारुणं M. 3. 5; नयनान्यरुणानि घूर्णयन् Ku. 4. 12. --2 Perplexed, embarrassed. --3 Dumb. --णः 1 Red colour, the colour of the dawn or morning twilight. --2 The dawn personified as the charioteer of the sun; आविष्कृतारुणपुरःसर एकतोर्कः Ś. 4. 1, 7. 4; विभावरी यद्यरुणाय कल्पते Ku. 5. 44; R. 5. 71. [Aruṇa is represented as the elder brother of Garuḍa, being the son of Vinatā by Kaśyapa. Vinatā prematurely hatched the egg and the child was born without thighs, and hence he is called Anūru ‘thighless’, or Vipāda ‘footless.’ He cursed his mother that since she had brought him forth before the due season she would be a slave to her rival Kadrū; but at her earnest entreaties, he modified the curse and said that her next son would deliver her from bondage. Aruṇa now holds the office of the charioteer of the sun. His wife was Śyenī, who bore him two sons Sampāti and Jaṭāyu]. --3 The sun; रागेण बालारुणकोमलेन Ku. 3. 30, 5. 8; संसृज्यते सरसिजैररुणांशुभिन्नैः R. 5. 69; Ś. 1. 32. --4 A kind of leprosy with red spots and insensibility of the skin. --5 A little poisonous creature. --6 N. of a plant पुंनाग; also a synonym of अर्क q. v. --7 Molasses (गुड) --8 N. of a peak of the Himālaya situated to the west of Kailāsa. --9 N. of one of the 12 Ādityas, the one presiding over Māgha. --णा 1 N. of several plants (a) अतिविषा (Mar. अतिविख); (b) Madder (मंजिष्ठा); (c) त्रिवृत् commonly called Teori; (d) a black kind of the same (श्यामाका); (e) bitter apple (इंद्रवारुणी); (f) the Guñja plant that yields the red and black berry (गुंज) used as a weight by jewellers &c. (g) मुंडतिक्ता. --2 N. of a river. --णी 1 A red cow (Nir.). --2 The early dawn. --णं 1 Red colour. --2 Gold. --3 Saffron. --Comp. --अग्रजः N. of Garuḍa (अरुणः अग्रजो यस्य). --अनुजः, --अवरजः N. of Garuḍa, younger brother of Aruṇa. --अर्चिस् m. the sun. --अश्व a. having red horses, epithet of the Maruts. --आत्मजः {1} son of Aruṇa, N. of Jaṭāyu. {2} N. of Saturn, Sāvarṇi Manu, Karṇa, Sugrīva, Yama and the two Aśvins. --(जा) N. of Yamunā and Tāptī. --ईक्षण a. red-eyed. --उदकं N. of a lake. --(का) N. of a river. --उदयः break of day, dawn; चतस्रो घटिकाः प्रातररुणोदय उच्यते. --उपलः a ruby. --कमलं a red lotus. --ज्योतिस् m. N. of Śiva. --दूर्वा reddish fennel. --प्रिय a. ‘beloved of red flowers and lotuses’, N. of the sun. --(या) {1} the sun's wife. {2} shadow. --प्सु a. [अरुणं प्सु रूपं यस्य] Ved. of reddish shape or colour. --बभ्रु a. reddish-yellow. --युज् a. furnished with red rays of light, epithet of the dawn. --लोचन a. red-eyed. --(नः) a pigeon. --सारथिः ‘having Aruṇa for his charioteer,’ the sun.

v: tri॰ aruRaH psuH rUpaM (niru॰) yasya । raktavarRarUpe “ftAvarImaruRapsuM viBAtIm” f॰ 5, 80, 1, “aruRapmumaruRarUpAm” BA॰ ।
m: अरुण—प्सु (अरुण-), mfn. of a red appearance, RV.
अरुण—पुष्पी f. the plant Pentapetes Phoenicea, L.
अरुण—पुष्प (अरुण-), mfn. having red flowers, ŚBr.
the blossom of a certain grass, KātyŚr.

s: puM, (aruRaH garuqAgrajaH sAraTiryasya saH .) sUryyaH । iti hemacandraH ॥
v: pu॰ aruRaH garuqAgrajaH sAraTirasya । sUryye vivaraRamanUruSabde ।
m: अरुण—सारथि m. ‘whose charioteer is Aruṇa’, the sun, L.
अरुण—स्मृति f. N. of wk.
अरुण—ता f. red colour, Śiś. ix, 14; Suśr.
अरुण—त्व n. id., Hcat.
अरुणय Nom. P. ˚यति, to redden, Kād.; (perf. Pass. p. अरुणित) reddened, Śiś. vi, 32; Kum. v, 11.
अरुण—युज् mfn. furnished with red (rays of light), RV. vi, 65, 2.
अरुणि m. N. of a Muni, BhP. (cf. आरुणि).
अरुणिमन् m. redness, ruddiness, Sāh.; Bālar.
a: अरुणिमन् — m., अरुणता Redness, red colour; अरुणिम्ना पिहितोपि शुक्लभावः Bv. 2. 180.

v: tri॰ aruRaM kriyate sma aruRa + kftyarTe Ric--karmmaRi kta, tArakAdi॰ itac vA । 1 raktavarRIkfte 2 jAtalohitavarRe ca । “stanANgarAgAruRitAcca kandukAt” kumA॰ ।
a: अरुणित, अरुणीकृत — a. Reddened, dyed red, impurpled; स्तनांगरागारुणिताच्च कंदुकात् Ku. 5. 11.

m: अरुणोद n. N. of a lake, VP.
of one of the seas surrounding the world, Jain.

v: na॰ aruRamudakaM yasya । 1 sarovaraBede । udakasya vA udAdeSe aruRodamapyatra । tacca saraH mandaragirirUpavizkamBaparvatasTam bi॰ pu॰ । 2 nadIBede strI sA ca “mandarotsaNga ekAdaSaSatayojanottuNgadevacUtaSirasogiriSIKarasTUlAni PalAnyamftakalpAni patanti । tezAMviSIryyamARAnAmati maDurasuraBisuganDivahalAruRarasodenAruRodA nAma nadI mandaragiriSiKarAnnipatantI pUrvveRelAvftamupaplAvayati” iti BAgavatoktasTalasTA ।

s: puM, (aruRasya bAlAdityasya udayo yatra saH .) sUryyodayAt pUrvvaM muhUrttadvayakAlaH । yaTA, -- “catasro GawikAH prAtararuRodaya ucyate । yatInAM snAnakAlo'yaM gaNgAmBaHsadfSaH smftaH” ॥ iti brahmavEvarttapurARaM ॥ (yaduktaM, -- “rajanISezayAmasya SezArdDamaruRodayaH” । iti । “mFn praSaMsatyajasraM yo GaRwAtAqo'ruRodaye” । iti manuH .)
v: pu॰ aruRasyArkasya tatkiraRasyodayo yatra । “catasro GawikAH prAta raruRodaya ucyate” ityukte sUryyodayAt prAci caturdaRqAtmake kAle ।
m: अरुणोदय m. break of day, dawn, Mn. x, 33

s: strI, (aruRodayakAle puRyaviSezajanikA yA saptamI .) mAGaSuklasaptamI । mAkarI saptamI । yaTA । Bavizye । “sUryyagrahaRatulyA hi SuklA mAGasya saptamI । aruRodayavelAyAM tasyAM snAnaM mahAPalaM ॥ mAGe mAsi site pakze saptamI kowiBAskarA । dadyAt snAnArGadAnAByAmAyurArogyasampadaH ॥ aruRodayavelAyAM SuklA mAGasya saptamI । gaNgAyAM yadi laByeta sUryyagrahaSatEH samA” ॥ kowiBAskarA kowisaptamItulyA । sUryyagrahaRaPalaM snAnajaM sannihite budDirantaraNgA iti nyAyAt । tena bahuSatasUryyagrahaRakAlInagaNgAsnAnajanyaPalasamaPalaprAptiH Palamatra jYeyaM । atra bahuSatasUryyagrahARAM pratyekADikaraRatAsaMsargeRAnvayAt kAlAnAM snAnAnAM tatPalAnAmapi bahuSatatvaM laByate । ato nAprasidDiH ॥ * ॥ pUrRasaptamyAM pUrvvAparayoryatrAruRodayakAle saptamI tatra pUrvvadine tatkAle snAnaM । “catasro GawikAH prAtaruRodaya ucyate । yatInAM srAnakAlo'yaM gaNgAmBaHsadfSaH smftaH ॥ triyAmAM rajanIM prAhustyaktvAdyantacatuzwayaM । nAqInAM taduBe sanDye divasAdyantasaMjYite” ॥ iti kAlamADavIyaDftabrahmavEvarttIyena pUrvvasya tatkAlasya pUrRatiTisambanDidinakarttavyakarmmANgatvena itarasya cetarANgatvenABiDAnAt । ataeva dakzeRa tatkAlamAraByAhnikakftyamaBihitaM ॥ * ॥ atrAruRodayakAle muhUrttAnyUnatiTilABa eva snAnaM । “vratopavAsasnAnAdO GawikEkA yadA Bavet । udaye sA tiTirgrAhyA SrAdDAdAvastagAminI” ॥ iti vizRuDarmmottarAt । atra GawikA muhUrttaM SrAdDayogyakAlAnuroDAditi vakzyate । brahmavEvarttavacane GawikA daRqarUpA । zaravacane nAqInAmAdyantacatuzwayamityekavAkyatvAt ॥ * ॥ ye tu sUryyodayAt prAgapi prAtaHsnAnaviDAnAt tatrEva mAGasaptamyAKyaguRaPalaviDirlAGavAdityAhustaccintyaM । prakaraRAnyatve prayojanAnyatvaM iti jEminisUtreRa prakaraRamede guRaviDyasidDeH । ataeva kalpataruratnAkarayoH । “ya icCedvipulAn BIgAn candrasUryyagrahopamAn । prAtaHsnAyI BavennityaM dvO mAsO mAGaPAlgunO” ॥ iti । vizRusmftO । “yaTAhani taTA prAtarnityaM snAyAdanAturaH” । iti nityasnAnaprakaraRAt prakaraRAntarAsnAnAt prakaraRAntarADikaraRanyAyena kAmyasnAnAntaramidamapyuktaM । na tu guRaPalaviDiH । kintu kAmyakaraRe prasaNgAnnityasidDiriti ॥ * ॥ atra mAGamAsanimittakamAGasaptamInimittakakAmyasnAnayoH prAtarviDAnAt nEmittikatvena prAyaScittavat sakfdanuzWAnaM । “praDAnasyAkriyA yatra sANgaM tat kriyate punaH । tadaNgasyAkriyAyAntu nAvfttirna ca tatkriyA” ॥ iti kAtyAyanavacanAt । “na snAnamAcaredBuktvA nAturo na mahAniSi । na vAsomiH sahAjasraM nAvijYAte jalASaye” ॥ iti manuvacanenEkadAjasrasnAnanizeDAt । “DarmmavinnAcaret snAnamAhnikaYca punaH punaH” ॥ iti manuvacanAcca । ataeva nAndImuKaprakaraRaSeze praDAnAnAmapi kAmyAnAM tattaddeSakAlavihitAnAM tantreREva sidDiriti SrAdDacintAmaRiH ॥ nizkAmavizRuprItikAmayoH sutarAM sakfdanuzWAnaM । guRatAratamyAt PalatAratamyaM iti nyAyena PalaM boDyaM । tattu ikzukzIraguqAdimADuryyaBedavannirddezwumaSakyaM । “pakzAntare'pi kanyAsTe ravO SrAdDaM praSasyata । kanyAgate paYcame tu viSezeREva kArayet” ॥ iti hemAdriDftAdityapurARoktavat । etadvacanaprAgardDaM kArttikamalamAsAbdavizayaM । “deSakAlASramakzetradravyadAtfmanoguRAH । sukfSasyApi dAnasya PalAtiSayahetavaH” ॥ iti brahmapurARoktavacca ॥ * ॥ tIrTaBede tvekadApi nAnAsnAnaM । “vizuvaddivase prApte paYcatIrTI viDAnataH” । iti brahmapurARAdivacanAt । “tIrTaBede tantraprasaNgayorasamBavAcca” । ataeva gaNgAvAkyAvalItIrTacintAmaRyoH । yattu prayAge tryahasnAne kroqIkfte'pi mAGasaptamIsnAnAdAvasADAraRasaNkalpena punastaTEva prAtaHsnAnAcaraRaM tadyuktaM tadA sakftsnAnasyEva vihitatvAt । anyaTA tattryahaPalakAmanAyAM tadAnantyApatterityuktaM ॥ * ॥ snAne paripAwImAha kftyakalpalatAyAM vizRuH । saptavadarapatrARi saptArkapatrARi ca Sirasi niDAya । “yadyajjanmakftaM pApaM mayA saptasu janmasu । tanme rokaYca SokaYca mAkarI hantu saptamI” ॥ ityuccAryya snAyAditiSezaH । rokaM CidraM । tiTikftyasya pOrRamAsyantamAsANgakatvAt mAkarIpadaM makarArkArabDacAndramAsIyatiTiparaM । “tiTikftye ca kfzRAdiM vrate SuklAdimeva ca । vivAhAdO ca sOrAdiM mAsaM kftye vinirddiSet” ॥ iti brahmapurARAnmanvantarAditvena taTA yuktatvAcca । yaTA matsyapurARe । “yasmAnmanvantarAdO tu raTamApurddivAkarAH । mAGamAsasya saptamyAM tasmAt sA raTasaptamI ॥ aruRodayavelAyAM tasyAM snAnaM mahAPalaM” । ataeva nArasiMhe raTyAKyAyAmityuktaM । yaTA, -- “mahAnavamyAM dvAdaSyAM BaraRyAmapi cEva hi । taTAkzayatfvIyAyAM SizyAnnADyApayedbuDaH ॥ mAGamAse tu saptamyAM raTyAKyAyAntu varjjayet” । dvAdaSyAM SayanotTAnadvAdaSyAM । BaraRyAM SakraDvajapAtaBaraRyAmiti kalpataruH ॥ atra mahAnavamyAdisAhacaryyAccAndratvaM pratIyate । ataeva caturddaSamanvantarAdigaRane kvApi na rASyulleKaH । yaTA । BavizyamatsyayoH । “aSvayuk SuklanavamI dvAdaSI kArttikI taTA । tftIyA cEtramAsasya taTA BAdrapadasya ca ॥ PAlgunasyApyamAvAsyA pOzasyEkAdaSI taTA । AzAQasyApi daSamI taTA mAGasya saptamI ॥ SrAvaRasyAzwamI kfzRA taTAzAQasya pUrRimA । kArttikI PAlgunI cEtrI jyEzWI paYcadaSI sitA ॥ manvantarAdayastvetA dattasyAkzayakArikAH” । atra amAvAsyAzwamIvyatiriktAH SuklAH punaHpunastaTApadopAkIrttanAdAnAt । upakramopasaMhArayoH SuklatvakIrttanAcca ॥ atra kAmaDenO tftoyA cEva mAGasyeti । kalpatarO tu tftIyA cEtramAsasyeti liKitaM । atra pAWadvEDe SrIpatiratnamAlAyAM । “aSvayuji SuklanavamI dvAdaSyUrjje maDO tftIyA ca” । iti pAWAccEtratftIyEva grAhyA । SrIdatto'pyevaM । mAGasaptamyAScAndratvaM sOrAgame'pi । “arkapatrEH savadarErdUrvvAkzatasacandanEH । azwANgaviDinA cArGyaM dadyAdAdityatuzwaye ॥ mAGe'Ta PAlgune vApi BavedvE mAGasaptamI । mAkarIti ca yatproktaM tatprAyovfttidarSanAt” ॥ azwANgaviDinA । “yo'zwANgamarGyamApUryya BAnormUrDni nivedayet । tAmrapAtrArGyadAnena puRyaM daSaguRaM smftaM” ॥ iti BavizyapurARIyena । AdityapurARe । “fkzarASiviSezeRa yatkarmma vihitaM narEH । dEvaM vApyaTavA pEtryaM tadanyatrApi dfSyate” ॥ * ॥ arGyamantrastu । “jananI sarvvaBUtAnAM saptamI saptasaptike । saptavyAhftike devi ! namaste ravimaRqale” ॥ praRAmamantrastu । “saptasaptivahaprIta saptalokapradIpana । saptamyAM hi namastuByaM namo'nantAya veDase” ॥ saptiraSvaH । iti tiTyAditattvaM ॥
v: strI aruRodayakAle puRyaviSezasADanaM saptamI । mAGaSuklasaptamyAm । “sUryyagraheRa tulyA hi SuklA mAGasya saptamI । aruRodayavelAyAM tasyAM snAnaM mahAPalam । mAGe mAsi site pakze saptamI kowiBAskarA । dadyAt snAnArGadAnAByAmAyurArogyasampadaH । aruRodayavelAyAM SuklA mAGasya saptamI । gaNgAyAM yadi laByeta sUryyagrahaSatEH sameti” ti॰ ta॰ Bavizya pu॰ ।
m: अरुणोदय—सप्तमी f. the seventh day in the bright half of Māgha, L.

v: strI aruRodayakAle vidDA । aruRodayakAle daSamyA vidDAyAmekAdaSyAm । “daSamISezasaMyuktA yadi syAdaruRodaye । vEzRavena na karttavyaM taddinEkAdaSIvratam” hemA॰ Bavi॰ pu॰ “aruRodayavidDA tu dvAdaSyAM pAraRA lABe'pi vEzRavErnopAsyA” e॰ ta॰ raGunandanaH ।

s: puM, (aruRaH upalaH, karmmaDArayaH .) raktavarRamaRiviSezaH । cunI iti BAzA । tatparyyAyaH । padmarAgaH 2 lohitakaH 3 lakzmIpuzpaH 4 । iti hemacandraH ॥
m: अरुणोपल m. a ruby, L.
अरुश n. N. of a Tantra.
अरुश—हन् m. (अरुश = अरुष?) striking the red (clouds), N. of Indra [killing enemies, Sāy.] RV. x, 116, 4.

v: tri॰ nAsti ruk kAntiryasya । prakASahIne malImase “ayaM rocayadarucorucAno'yam” f॰ 6, 39, 4 ॥
m: अ-रुच् mfn. lightless, RV. vi, 39, 4.
a: अरुच् — a. Ved. Lightless, dark.

s: puM, (na ruciryatra saH .) rogaBedaH । sa ca satyaBilAze'ByavahArAsAmarTyarUpaH । iti rakzitaH ॥ tatparyyAyaH । arocakaH 2 aSradDA 3 anaBilAzaH 4 । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥ (“dozEH pfTak saha ca cittaviparyyayAYca, BaktAyanezu hfdi cAvatate pragAQaM । nAnne rucirBavati taM Bizajo vikAraM, BaktopaGAtamiha paYcaviDaM vadanti” ॥ iti suSrutaH । alaNkAraSAstroktadaSaviDasmaradaSAmaDye parigaRito vastuvErAgyarUpaH smaradaSAviSezaH, yaTA sAhityadarpaRe, -- “aNkezvasOzWavaM tApaH pARqutA kfSatA'ruciH । arucirvastuvErAgyaM sarvvatrArAgitA DftiH” ॥
v: pu॰ na ruciryatra । satyapyaBilAze 1 BojanAyogyatA sampAdake 1 rogaBede । na ruciH santozaH na॰ ta॰ । 2 santozABAve ‘ityarucerAha’ jagadISaH । pUrvvodBAvitadozasya SiTilatvaSaNkayA santozABAvAdityarTaH । BojanAdO 3 aBilAzABAve ca “sannipAtakzayaSvAsakASahikkA'rucipranut” “syAddurvirikte kaPapittakopo dAho'rucirgOravamagnisAdaH” iti ca suSrutaH ।
m: अ-रुचि f. want of appetite, disgust, Suśr.
aversion, dislike, Sāh.; Kād. (with उपरि).
a: अरुचिः — f. 1 Aversion, dislike in general; क्व सा भोगानामुपर्यरुचिः K. 146. --2 Want of appetite, disrelish, disgust; सन्निपातक्षयश्वासकासहिक्कारुचिप्रणुत् Suśr. --3 Absence of a satisfactory explanation.

m: अ-रुचिर mfn. disagreeable, disgusting.
a: अरुचिर, अरुच्य — a. Disagreeable, disgusting.

m: अ-रुचित mfn. not agreeable or suitable to, ŚBr. xiv
अ-रुच्य mfn. id., L.
अ-रुद्ध mfn. not hindered.

v: tri॰ rugRaH viroDe na॰ ta॰ । svasTe rogaSUnye “rujadarugRaM vibalasya sAnum” f॰ 6, 39, 2 ।
m: अ-रुग्ण mfn. unbroken, RV. vi, 39, 2.
a: अरुग्ण — a. Not broken, not diseased, sound.

s: strI, (rohati, ruha + ka, naYsamAsaH .) BUDAtrI । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥ BUmi AmalA iti KyAtA ।
v: strI na kiYcinmlamASritya rohati ruha + ka । BUmyAmalakyAm rAjani॰ । kfSA॰ CaR । AruhIyam tatsannikfzwadeSAdO tri॰ ।
m: अ-रुहा f. N. of a plant, L.
a: अरुहा — N. of a plant(भूम्यामलकी).

m: अ-रुज् mfn. painless (as a tumour), Suśr.
free from disease, sound, healthy.
अ-रुज् & अ-रुज. See अ-रुग्ण.
a: अरुज् — a. 1 Free from disease, sound, healthy. --2 Not festering (as a boil).

s: puM, (rujati, ruj + ka, naYsamAsaH .) AragbaDavfkzaH । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥ so~dAli iti BAzA । (svanAmaKyAtadAnavaviSezaH । “prahlAdo'SvaSirAH kumBaH saMhrAdo gaganapriyaH । anuhrAdo hariharO varAhaH saMharo'rujaH” ॥ iti harivaMSe .)
v: tri॰ nAsti ruk rogo yasya । 1 rogaSUnye 2 anutpannaroge ca “ko'ruk ko'rukko'ruk “iti praSne” GftaBugamitaBugaSAkaBuk so'rugityadBawaH “aruk saevApyacalo mahAMSca marmmotTitaScApi vivarjjanIyaH” suSrutaH ।

pu॰ na rujati ruja--ka । (soMdAla) iti KyAte 1 vfkze । nAsti rujA yasmAt 5 ba॰ । 2 rogABAvasADane tri॰ “vizeByaH Kalu sarvveByaH karRikAmarujAM sTirAm” suSrutaH । 3 dAnavaBede pu॰ dAnavagaRanAyAM harivaM॰ “anuhrAdo hari hayovarAhaH saMhAro'rujaH” । 6 ta॰ । 4 rogaSUnyenIroge ca tri॰ । “apAkakaWinaH sTUlogranTirvartmaBavo'rujaH” suSrutaH । “arujaM vA hyataH SUnamantaH klinnaM sravatyapi” suSru॰ ।
m: अ-रुज mf(आ)n. painless (as a tumour, &c.), Suśr.
free from disease, sound, Suśr. &c.
brisk, gay, R. vii, 84, 16
अ-रुज m. the plant Cassia Fistula
N. of a Dānava, Hariv. 14286.
a: अरुज — a. 1 Sound, healthy; यावत्स्वस्थमिदं शरीरमरुजं Bh. 3. 88. v. l. --2 Not breaking, not suppurating. --जः N. of a plant (आरग्वध).

m: अरुल n. water, L.
a small boat, L.

s: strI, (na runDatI .) vaSizWapatnI । tatparyyAyaH । akzamAlA 2 । iti hemacandraH ॥ sA kardamamunikanyA mahAsADvI । iti SrIBAgavataM ॥ AkASe saptarzimaDye vaSizWasanniDO tasyA udayaH । gatAyuzastAM naM paSyanti । (yaduktaM, -- “dIpanirvvARaganDaYca suhfdvAkyamarunDatIM । na jiGranti na SfRvanti na paSyanti gatAyuzaH” ॥ yaTA ca suSrute, -- “na paSyati sa nakzatrAM yaSca devImarunDatIM । DruvamAkASagaNgAM vA taM vadanti gatAyuzaM” ॥) saptapadIgamanAnantaraM jAmAtA mantraM pAWayan baDUM tAM darSayati ca ॥

the wife of Vasiṣṭha, R. &c.

the little and scarcely visible star Alcor (belonging to the Great Bear, and personified as the wife of one of its seven chief stars, Vasiṣṭha, or of all the seven, the so-called seven Ṛṣis; at marriage ceremonies Arundhatī is invoked as a pattern of conjugal excellence by the bridegroom), ĀśvGṛ. &c.
